headline: Two Prime-Time Wins Make Caleb Williams' No. 18 a Must-Have
title: Caleb Williams Jersey: Bears QB Shines in Prime Time
subheadline: Chicago beat both of last season's Super Bowl teams in back-to-back prime-time games, and the third-year quarterback is driving the 6-2 start.
description: Caleb Williams led Chicago past Seattle 34-17 on Nov. 2, a week after beating New England. Here is why his No. 18 Bears jersey is the one to own this fall.
searchIntent: Bears fans who watched the Monday night win in Seattle want to know why Williams is trending and which of his jerseys to get.
body: Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears went into Seattle on Monday night and beat the defending champions 34-17. Williams completed 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards and a touchdown, and Chicago led from the opening drive to the final whistle.
The Bears are now 6-2.
## Why fans are buying in

The Seattle win came right after a 30-24 Thursday night win over New England on Oct. 22, when Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns. According to NFL Research, that makes Chicago the first team in league history to beat both of the previous season's Super Bowl teams in back-to-back prime-time games.

Both wins came after he missed time with a right hamstring injury. In the New England game he became the first Bears quarterback since Mitch Trubisky in 2018 to throw for 300 yards in consecutive games.

National television is where a quarterback's reputation gets built, and Williams has now had two big showcases in 12 days. The first one also came against Drake Maye, a fellow member of the 2024 draft class, which gave it extra weight for Chicago fans.

He was already the face of the franchise. Chicago took him first overall in 2024, and he is the cover athlete for Madden NFL 27, the first Bears player to get that spot. In our view, winning in prime time is what turns a well-known young quarterback into the jersey a whole city wants. This is our analysis, not a sales figure.
## The look

Williams wears No. 18. His jersey comes in Chicago's classic navy home look, the white road version and the orange alternate, and the banner above shows each style. Navy is the safe pick for Soldier Field, while the orange alternate is the one that stands out in a crowd.
## Why this jersey will last
Williams is 24, he is healthy again and his team is in the thick of the NFC North race. Chicago hosts Tampa Bay next Sunday night, another chance to play on a national stage.

headline: Passing Gretzky Adds a New Chapter to Connor McDavid's No. 97
title: Connor McDavid Jersey: Oilers Star Passes a Gretzky Mark
subheadline: McDavid reached 30 assists in 15 games, the fastest in NHL history, breaking a Wayne Gretzky record from 1984-85.
description: Connor McDavid became the fastest player in NHL history to 30 assists on Nov. 1, topping a Gretzky mark. Here is why his No. 97 Oilers jersey is one to own.
searchIntent: Hockey fans who saw McDavid pass Gretzky want to know what the record is and which of his Oilers jerseys to get.
body: Connor McDavid now holds a record that used to belong to Wayne Gretzky. In a 4-1 win over the New York Rangers on Nov. 1 at Madison Square Garden, he scored a goal and added an assist, reaching 30 assists in just 15 games. That is the fastest any player has done it in NHL history, one game quicker than Gretzky in 1984-85.
He has also recorded an assist in all 15 of Edmonton's games, extending an NHL-record assist streak to open a season.
## Why fans are buying in

Passing Gretzky carries extra weight in Edmonton, where Gretzky built the franchise's legend. McDavid added more Oilers history the same night. His goal, 50 seconds into the game, was his eighth career goal in an opening minute, a team record that moved him past Mark Messier.
It was also his 418th career goal, which put him alone in fourth place on the Oilers' all-time list. Only Gretzky, Jari Kurri and Leon Draisaitl have more.

The team is rolling with him. Edmonton is 11-2-2 and 7-0-0 on the road, and NHL.com notes that McDavid, Draisaitl and Evan Bouchard have combined for 93 points, the most by three teammates through 15 games in 30 years.

McDavid was already one of the league's biggest draws. He ranked No. 5 on the NHL's list of top-selling jerseys for the 2025-26 regular season, based on online sales at Shop.NHL.com and the Fanatics network. A record chase like this one, in our analysis, gives fans a new reason to buy in, and it is not a sales figure.
## The look

McDavid wears No. 97. His jersey comes in Edmonton's royal blue home look and an orange Power Play style, and the banner above shows each one. The royal blue is the everyday pick for game nights, while the orange is the one that stands out in a crowd.
## Why this jersey will last
A record that once belonged to Gretzky is the kind of milestone fans remember for years, and McDavid's season is barely a month old. The next target is how long the streak can run.

headline: Cutter Gauthier's Comeback Hat Trick Puts His No. 61 in the Spotlight
title: Cutter Gauthier Jersey: The Ducks Star's Comeback Hat Trick
subheadline: The 22-year-old scored three times as Anaheim erased a 3-0 deficit and beat Ottawa 6-3, only the second such win in team history.
description: Cutter Gauthier scored a hat trick as the Ducks rallied from 3-0 down to beat Ottawa 6-3 on Nov. 1. Here is why his No. 61 jersey is one to get early.
searchIntent: Ducks and hockey fans who saw the comeback want to know how good Gauthier has been and where to get his jersey.
body: Cutter Gauthier turned a lopsided night into one of the best wins in Anaheim Ducks history. Ottawa led 3-0 after the first period on Nov. 1 at Honda Center. Gauthier started the comeback early in the second and finished it with two goals in the first three minutes of the third, his second career hat trick, as Anaheim won 6-3.
## Why fans are buying in

The Ducks scored six goals in a row, and NHL.com notes it was only the second time the team has won by three or more after trailing by three or more. The first came against the Hartford Whalers in January 1994.

Gauthier has been the engine. He has five goals in his past two games and points in four straight, and he put 15 shots on goal across those two games. That follows a 2025-26 season in which he scored 41 goals with 69 points in 76 games.
His path to Anaheim is part of the appeal. Philadelphia drafted him fifth overall in 2022, and he was traded to the Ducks, where he has grown into a top goal scorer at 22.

He is also part of a young core that is starting to click. Leo Carlsson had three assists in the win, his second straight three-assist game, and Anaheim has scored at least five goals in four straight games. The Ducks are 6-7-1 after a rough start, and in our view a young team that scores like this tends to build a fan base fast. This is our analysis, not a sales figure.
## The look

Gauthier wears No. 61, an unusual number that makes his jersey easy to spot in the stands. It comes in the Ducks' bright orange home look, shown in the banner above. It is one of the brightest looks in the league and an easy pick for game night.
## Why this jersey will last

A 22-year-old who has already scored 40 goals in a season is a player fans can grow with. If the Ducks keep climbing, Gauthier will be at the center of it, and fans who get his jersey now will have had it from the start.
